missing_information_behavior: Review dietary sources, preparation methods, fortified foods and current supplements before considering zinc.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer zinc deficiency solely from vegan status.
Do not claim zinc gluconate is superior because the user is vegan.
Do not duplicate zinc or exceed upper limits.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, malabsorption, chronic diarrhea, restrictive diet, prolonged high-dose zinc or relevant medicine interactions.
population_and_context: People following vegan diets; phytate-rich plant foods can reduce zinc bioavailability, but vegan status alone does not establish deficiency or require zinc gluconate.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Assess total elemental zinc and life-stage reference values; consider dietary bioavailability and upper limits.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Zinc fact sheet describes plant-food phytates and zinc bioavailability; dietary pattern alone is not a diagnosis. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
